installed_chrony_dropin:
# Drop-in for the dedicated pilot's chrony.service.
[Service]
Type=forking
ExecStartPre=
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/python3 /usr/libexec/cura-agrorum/check-chrony.py /etc/chrony/chrony.conf
ExecStart=
ExecStart=!/usr/sbin/chronyd -F 1 -f /etc/chrony/chrony.conf
Restart=on-failure
# chronyc binds a reply socket beside the daemon socket. Start privately,
# then expose only the receiver group; sticky mode protects daemon entries.
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0700
# Keep this one command: systemd reapplies RuntimeDirectory ownership/mode
# before each command and would undo an earlier post-start adjustment.
ExecStartPost=+/bin/sh -c "/usr/bin/chgrp cura-receiver /run/chrony /run/chrony/chronyd.sock && /usr/bin/chmod 01770 /run/chrony && /usr/bin/chmod 0660 /run/chrony/chronyd.sock"
